name: orlynx
description: Orlynx — GitHub-native AI development workspace (phone-first PWA, control plane + replaceable compute plane)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@orlynx/api & npm run dev --workspace=@orlynx/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@orlynx/shared && npm run build --workspace=@orlynx/bridge && npm run build --workspace=@orlynx/api && npm run build --workspace=@orlynx/web && npm run build --workspace=@orlynx/runtime-worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@orlynx/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
